novelty.justification: The claim hypothesizes a "graded epistemic-strength axis distinct from truth" that is "causally steerable" and can be aligned with answer confidence, so its novelty route is chiefly an ordinal lexical measurement of epistemic strength rather than a new general intervention paradigm. Searches using "LLM verbalized confidence activation steering orthogonal direction calibration," "epistemic modality latent representations LLM," and "linguistic assertiveness internal certainty" identify the closest work as Closing the Confidence-Faithfulness Gap in Large Language Models (2026), which already probes orthogonal internal confidence and verbalization signals and steers the latter toward the model's internal accuracy estimate; Epistemic Integrity in Large Language Models (2024) and Representations of Fact, Fiction and Forecast in Large Language Models: Epistemics and Attitudes (2025) additionally cover linguistic assertiveness and latent epistemic expressions. Replacing numeric or general confidence verbalization with the ordered verbs "suspect < think < believe < know < certain" is therefore a natural, fairly direct transfer of existing probing-and-steering work to a more fine-grained lexical scale, not a new core mechanistic relationship.
